name: Website and sign-in
description: Visitor can explore public website and sign into a private workspace.
steps: Open the marketing homepage and review feature sections
Click Get started and complete the authentication popup
Confirm the private workspace overview becomes visible
expected: Public marketing content is accessible; after sign-in the workspace overview and navigation are visible.

name: Create customer and quotation records
description: Records can be created, edited, searched and retained after refresh.
steps: Add a customer named Alpha Printworks
Edit that customer and save an updated note
Open Quotations and add Alpha Printworks quote with amount 2500
Refresh and search for Alpha Printworks
expected: Customer and quotation remain saved and searchable, and dashboard totals reflect them.

name: Invoice and follow-up management
description: Mobile users can manage operations and see totals.
steps: Sign in on a mobile viewport
Open Invoices and add a paid invoice amount 2000
Open Follow-ups and add a pending customer follow-up
expected: Saved records remain visible and analytics shows KSh 2,000 paid.

name: Invalid and destructive actions
description: Invalid entries are rejected and deletions require approval.
steps: Sign in, open Customers and click Add customer
Leave name empty and click Save record
Create a record named Delete Example, click its delete icon and confirm
expected: Empty name is not saved and a confirmed deletion removes Delete Example.

name: AI drafting assistant
description: AI can draft useful language for review and show a failure message when unavailable.
steps: Sign in and navigate to Quotations
Open AI draft and ask for a professional quotation introduction
Generate the draft and inspect the editable suggestion
expected: The generated wording is visible in an editable field with a reminder to verify information.
